title: Cloud Orchard
theme: A tiny cloud-spirit tends a floating orchard, swapping weather tiles to gather glow for a sky lantern.
mechanics: Swap adjacent tiles to match three or more
Cleared tiles add glow to the sky lantern
Reach the glow target before moves run out
Three hand-authored gardens with rising targets
